14135-punch-or-the-london-charivari-volu.title: Punch Or The London Charivari Volume 152 January 10 1917
14135-punch-or-the-london-charivari-volu.creator: Unknown
14135-punch-or-the-london-charivari-volu.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It is explained by a railway official that a passenger who pays threepence for a ticket to-day is really only giving the company twopence, the rest being water, owing to the decline in the purchasing power of money. A movement is now on foot among some of the regular passengers to endeavour to persuade the companies to consent to take their fares neat for the future.

arxiv-1905-07286.title: A deep learning approach to detecting volcano deformation from satellite imagery using synthetic datasets Journal: Remote Sensing of Environment
arxiv-1905-07286.creator: N. Anantrasirichai, J. Biggs, F. Albino, D. Bull
arxiv-1905-07286.description: Abstract Satellites enable widespread, regional or global surveillance of volcanoes and can provide the first indication of volcanic unrest or eruption. Here we consider Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR), which can be employed to detect surface deformation with a strong statistical link to eruption.

arxiv-2105-07885.title: A family of weighted Erdős-Mordell inequality and applications
arxiv-2105-07885.creator: Tran Quang Hung
arxiv-2105-07885.description: Abstract . We establish some new generalizations of Erdős-Mordell inequality by adding weights to its terms. Using these generalizations, we derived strengthened versions of the original Erdős-Mordell inequality. We also found two other variations of Erdős-Mordell inequality to be generalizable in the same way. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 51M04, 51M16 1.

arxiv-2107-13950.title: Twisted Rota-Baxter operators on 3 3 -Lie algebras and NS- 3 3 -Lie algebras
arxiv-2107-13950.creator: Shuai Hou, Yunhe Sheng
arxiv-2107-13950.description: Abstract . In this paper, first we introduce the notion of a twisted Rota-Baxter operator on a 3 3 -Lie algebra 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} with a representation on V V . We show that a twisted Rota-Baxter operator induces a 3-Lie algebra structure on V V , which represents on 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} .

arxiv-2308-16000.title: Hypothesis-driven mediation analysis for compositional data: an application to gut microbiome
arxiv-2308-16000.creator: Noora Kartiosuo, Jaakko Nevalainen, Olli Raitakari, Katja Pahkala, Kari Auranen
arxiv-2308-16000.description: Abstract Biological sequencing data consist of read counts, e.g. of specified taxa and often exhibit sparsity (zero-count inflation) and overdispersion (extra-Poisson variability). As most sequencing techniques provide an arbitrary total count, taxon-specific counts should ideally be treated as proportions under the compositional data-analytic framework.

arxiv-2410-19104.title: Mittag-Leffler Probability Density for Nonextensive Statistics and Superstatistics
arxiv-2410-19104.creator: A.M. Mathai
arxiv-2410-19104.description: Abstract Abstract It is shown that a Mittag-Leffler density has interesting properties. The Mittag-Leffler random variable has a structural representation in terms of a positive Lévy variable and a power of a gamma variable where these two variables are independently distributed.

arxiv-2505-01670.title: Efficient Multi Subject Visual Reconstruction from fMRI Using Aligned Representations
arxiv-2505-01670.creator: Christos Zangos, Danish Ebadulla, Thomas Sprague, Ambuj Singh
arxiv-2505-01670.description: Abstract This work introduces a novel approach to fMRI-based visual image reconstruction using a subject-agnostic common representation space. We show that the brain signals of the subjects can be aligned in this common space during training to form a semantically aligned common brain.

arxiv-2506-00951.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for the Relativistic Burgers Equation in the Exterior of a Schwarzschild Black Hole
arxiv-2506-00951.creator: Shuyang Xiang
arxiv-2506-00951.description: Abstract We introduce a Physics-Informed Neural Networks(PINN) to solve a relativistic Burgers equation in the exterior domain of a Schwarzschild black hole. Our main contribution is a PINN architecture that is able to simulate shock wave formations in such curved spacetime, by training a shock-aware network block and introducing a Godunov-inspired residuals in the loss function.

arxiv-2508-02814.title: Nonreciprocal Model B: The role of mobilities and nonreciprocal interfacial forces
arxiv-2508-02814.creator: Bibhut Sahoo, Rituparno Mandal, Peter Sollich
arxiv-2508-02814.description: Abstract We study a non-reciprocal version of Model B, as the continuum theory for non-reciprocal particle mixtures. In contrast to non-reciprocal Cahn-Hilliard models, it is important in this context to consider the dependence of mobility coefficients on the local concentrations.

arxiv-2605-26124.title: Astrophysical environment around a black hole in the braneworld and its optical signatures
arxiv-2605-26124.creator: and A. Sulaksono

britannica-1911-aetolia.title: Aetolia (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-aetolia.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-aetolia.description: Article 'Aetolia' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 1), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. In early legend Old Aetolia, with its cities of Pleuron and Calydon, figures prominently. During the great migrations (see Dorians) the population was largely displaced, and the old inhabitants long remained in a backward condition. In the 5th century some tribes were still living in open villages under petty kings, addicted to plunder and piracy, and hardly recognized as Hellenes at all.

pmc-10535850.title: The Prevalence of Human Plasmodium Species during Peak Transmission Seasons from 2016 to 2021 in the Rural Commune of Ntjiba, Mali
pmc-10535850.creator: Francois Dao, Laurent Dembele, Bakoroba Diarra, Fanta Sogore, Alejandro Marin-Menendez, Siaka Goita, Aboubacrin S. Haidara, Yacouba N. Barre, Cheick P. O. Sangare, Aminatou Kone, Dinkorma T. Ouologuem, Antoine Dara, Mamadou M. Tekete, Arthur M. Talman, Abdoulaye A. Djimde
pmc-10535850.description: Up-to-date knowledge of key epidemiological aspects of each Plasmodium species is necessary for making informed decisions on targeted interventions and control strategies to eliminate each of them. This study aims to describe the epidemiology of plasmodial species in Mali, where malaria is hyperendemic and seasonal.

pmc-10753892.title: Noncontact Layer Stabilization of Azafullerene Radicals: Route toward High-Spin-Density Surfaces
pmc-10753892.creator: Yuri Tanuma, Gregor Kladnik, Luca Schio, Marion van Midden Mavrič, Bastien Anézo, Erik Zupanič, Gregor Bavdek, Ruben Canton-Vitoria, Luca Floreano, Nikos Tagmatarchis, Hermann A Wegner, Alberto Morgante, Christopher P Ewels, Dean Cvetko, Denis Arčon
pmc-10753892.description: We deposit azafullerene C59N• radicals in a vacuum on the Au(111) surface for layer thicknesses between 0.35 and 2.1 monolayers (ML). The layers are characterized using X-ray photoemission (XPS) and X-ray absorption fine structure (NEXAFS) spectroscopy, low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy (STM), and by density functional calculations (DFT).

pmc-11437717.title: The spatial relationship between leishmaniases and sand flies in Europe and neighboring countries
pmc-11437717.creator: Eduardo Berriatua, Pedro Pérez-Cutillas, Aurora González Vidal, Olivier J. T. Briët
pmc-11437717.description: BackgroundLeishmania infantum is endemic in Europe (and elsewhere) while L. donovani s.s., L. tropica and L. major are not but are present in neighboring countries in North Africa, the Middle East, (the Asian part of) Turkey and the Southern Caucasus.

pmc-11503937.title: Imaging and Simulation of Ruthenium Derivative Coating Microbeads at the Opaque Electrode with Electrogenerated Chemiluminescence
pmc-11503937.creator: Yanlong Feng, Wenshuai Zhou, Xiaofei Wang, Jian Zhang, Min Zou, Chengxiao Zhang, Honglan Qi
pmc-11503937.description: Electrogenerated chemiluminescence (ECL) imaging is gaining increasing attention in various fields because of its high sensitivity, low background, and good temporal and spatial resolution. However, ECL imaging of microsized objects at the opaque electrode via top-view configuration is challenged with the reactants’ diffusion and light propagation.

pmc-11655355.title: Stereochemistry in the disorder–order continuum of protein interactions
pmc-11655355.creator: Estella A. Newcombe, Amanda D. Due, Andrea Sottini, Steffie Elkjær, Frederik Friis Theisen, Catarina B. Fernandes, Lasse Staby, Elise Delaforge, Christian R. O. Bartling, Inna Brakti, Katrine Bugge, Benjamin Schuler, Karen Skriver, Johan G. Olsen, Birthe B. Kragelund
pmc-11655355.description: Intrinsically disordered proteins can bind via the formation of highly disordered protein complexes without the formation of three-dimensional structure1. Most naturally occurring proteins are levorotatory (l)—that is, made up only of l-amino acids—imprinting molecular structure and communication with stereochemistry2. By contrast, their mirror-image dextrorotatory (d)-amino acids are rare in nature.

pmc-11713682.title: A Cross Cultural Understanding of Diverse Dementia Journeys
pmc-11713682.creator: Mary Chi Michael
pmc-11713682.description: BackgroundOver the past 3 years, the Global Council on Alzheimer’s Disease (GCAD) has conducted research on lived experience and care partner journeys. Specifically, this research has focused on the experiences of individuals from historically underrepresented populations, including LGBTQ+, Black, Hispanic/Latino, and Asian communities.

pmc-12745149.title: Longitudinal trajectories of left ventricular myocardial remodeling: associations with cardiovascular risk factors in the multi-ethnic study of atherosclerosis
pmc-12745149.creator: Charlène A Mauger, Bharath Ambale-Venkatesh, Avan Suinesiaputra, David A Bluemke, Colin O Wu, Joao AC Lima, Alistair A Young
pmc-12745149.description: BackgroundUnderstanding the influence of cardiovascular risk factors on longitudinal cardiac remodeling requires three-dimensional analysis of longitudinal shape changes beyond scalar indicators such as mass and volumes. The aim of this study is to determine trajectories of cardiovascular risk factor-related remodeling in a large cohort imaging study.

pmc-13013414.title: Iron deficiency and reduced exercise tolerance in adult Fontan patients
pmc-13013414.creator: Agnieszka Bartczak-Rutkowska, Olga Trojnarska, Sonia Nartowicz, Agata Markiewicz, Maciej Lesiak, Ewa Straburzyńska-Migaj
pmc-13013414.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe Fontan procedure allows patients with complex congenital heart defects unsuitable for biventricular repair to reach adulthood; however, it results in a non-physiological circulation characterized by chronically elevated systemic venous pressure, impaired preload, and multiple long-term complications. Iron deficiency (ID), a well-recognized determinant of reduced exercise capacity and adverse prognosis in heart failure, may also affect adults with Fontan circulation, yet data remain scarce.

pmc-13218602.title: Un système de santé privé parallèle ne fera que détériorer l’accès aux interventions chirurgicales financées par l’État
pmc-13218602.creator: Robert M Mayall, Stephanie E Hastings, Braden J Manns
pmc-13218602.description: le projet de loi 11, qui autorise les médecins à exercer en pratique mixte, c’est-à-dire à travailler dans le système public et à facturer ce dernier pour les services, tout en acceptant une patientèle privée qui paie de sa poche (https://www.alberta.ca/supporting-a-world-class-health-care-system). Dans un premier temps, cette mesure concerne les interventions chirurgicales non urgentes.

pmc-13624340.title: Uncertainty and novel clinical trial designs in oncology – when should equipoise matter?
pmc-13624340.creator: Sarah Heynemann, Wendy Lipworth, Sue-Anne McLachlan, Jennifer Philip, Tom John, Ian Kerridge
pmc-13624340.description: Equipoise is usually considered a requirement for the ethical conduct of phase III randomised controlled trials. Notwithstanding theoretical critiques since the concept’s initial proposal, equipoise has remained an important moral consideration. In oncology, many research questions are now pursued via clinical trial designs that diverge in various ways from conventional, fixed-design, two-arm randomised controlled trials.
